description: This file defines classes and enums for Bluetooth AVDTP signaling and socket communication, including Payload, Signal, and Socket classes with methods for handling Bluetooth signaling protocols.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: Represents AVDTP payload data, derived from DataRecordBE, with builder and inspector function types.

classes.name: Signal
classes.description: Represents AVDTP signaling messages, with enums for signal identifiers, error codes, message types, and packet types, and methods for serialization, deserialization, and inspection.

classes.name: Socket
classes.description: Manages Bluetooth AVDTP socket communication, handling signaling, transport, reporting, and recovery channels, with nested Request, Response, and ResponseHandler classes.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the signal or socket data into a byte stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into signal or socket data.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets signal parameters such as label, identifier, and message type.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming signal with optional payload.

methods.name: Reject
methods.description: Rejects an incoming signal with error code and optional data.

methods.name: Operational
methods.description: Abstract method to handle socket operational state changes.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles socket state changes, updates MTU, and calls Operational.
